constructive_primitive: For any native even-level word and m>=n+2, low GF3 Gaussian elimination gives three distinct words with componentwise low frequency sum zero. Their full-root relative phases have an exact odd-level native label at unchanged modulus.
source_law: Uniform independent classical anchor: conditional high output pairs are uniform; GL-equivariant low output is zero/uniform-nonzero mixture with exponentially small zero bound at growing n.
incoming_access: For full-rank m=n+2 anchors, polynomially many cases reduce one endpoint to linear equations and the other to three-choice modular witnesses over F3. Equations are supplied, not a complete coherent incoming oracle.
conditional_geometry: Unfiltered native inverse-case second moments yield polynomial incidence-degree second moment; a specified full-rank/degree-truncated constant-weight frame has inverse-polynomial native-average mass and near-uniform odd output IF compiled.
implemented_reference_only: Bounded explicit exponential cube tables, rational primal/dual LP cover certificates and complete flat-input branch replay. This differently weighted reference does not inherit the conditional cover's accepted-source law.

proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-INCOMING: Supply a complete reversible bounded-cost incident-edge indexer, including three-choice cases and rank/degree failures, or a different explicit measurement circuit.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-COHERENCE: No anchor pointer or solver history distinguishes the accepted corners; provide actual Naimark/isometry access without free unknown preparation or inverse.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-NORMALIZATION: Compile true degree truncation and Kraus normalization, with all failures charged and no omitted incoming edges.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-SOURCE: Prove the implemented compiler's actual Born-weighted source law and all higher native phases, not only a uniform classical-anchor law.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-THROUGHPUT: A one-output-per-n+2 stage still has quasi-polynomial growing-depth cost. Supply a multi-output, correlated or collective advantage before claiming breakthrough leverage.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-BASELINES: Compare the complete known sieve and legal low-modulus arithmetic attacks, not merely LP feasibility or a fast pointed finder.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-REVIEW: Independent review of pointed, GL-source, inverse-case and degree-truncation derivations.

falsifiers: A genuine native source triple fails full-root odd-label conformance.
A full-rank incoming anchor is omitted by compiled inverse cases.
A source-average inverse-case second moment exceeds its exact formula.
The compiler treats an outgoing nonbijective endpoint map as an in-place unitary.
The apparent speedup relies on3^m table compilation, independent triple postselection, or uncharged unknown-state access.
The claimed Shor-level contribution is only a constant/exponent improvement within an unchanged quasi-polynomial one-output sieve.
